check_in.title: Kwinjira ukoresheje ibiranga umubiri
check_in.intro: Ibimenyetso by'isura ku muryango. Umuryango wemera buri gihe hakoreshejwe ikarita y'ubutumire n'indangamuntu yanditswe.
check_in.failed_body: Nta cyahindutse ku muryango: injiza hakoreshejwe ubutumire n'indangamuntu yanditswe.

mode_body.OFF: Nta bimenyetso by'isura bifatwa muri iki kigo.
mode_body.SHADOW: Ibimenyetso by'isura bibikwa gusa ngo bizagenzurwe. Nta cyerekanwa hano kandi ntawangwa abiturutseho.
mode_body.ADVISORY: Ibimenyetso by'isura byerekanwa nk'inama. Umukozi niwe ufata icyemezo.

check_in.no_match: Isura itahuye ntiyigera ituma umuntu yangwa. Ohereza umukandida ku mugenzuzi ngo amenyekanishwe ku ntoki.

conflicts.title: Amakimbirane y'amanota atakemutse
conflicts.intro: Amanota seriveri yafashe kuko ibipimo bibiri bivuguruzanya.
conflicts.none: Nta manota afashwe kuri iyi tableti.
conflicts.metrics: Uburebure {{height}} cm, ibiro {{weight}} kg, igituza {{chest}} cm, kwiruka {{run}} s
conflicts.server_holds: Seriveri ibitse ibipimo byombi kugeza ukemuye.

verdict.NOT_FOUND: Nta busabe nk'ubwo mu kigo cyawe.
verdict.SCORE_NOT_FOUND: Ubusabe burahari, ariko ayo manota ntayo.

verdict.NONE_SAVED: NTA KIMWE CYABITSWE. Amanota {{rejected}} yose yanzwe: ongera uyafate mbere yo kuva aho.

biometric.invalid_invitation: Ubu butumire ntibwemewe. Kurikiza uburyo bwo kugenzura ku ntoki.

error.NOT_FOUND: Nta busabe nk'ubwo mu kigo cyawe.
error.SCORE_NOT_FOUND: Ubusabe burahari, ariko ayo manota ntayo.

ticket.label: Ikarita y'umukandida (soma cyangwa wandike)
ticket.help: Soma QR ukoresheje kamera cyangwa igikoresho gifatwa mu ntoki.
ticket.unreadable: Iyi si ikarita yatanzwe n'iyi sisitemu.
ticket.not_this_venue_title: Iyi karita ntiri iy'aha hantu no kuri uyu munsi
ticket.no_venue_day: Banza wemeze ahantu n'umunsi ku rupapuro rwo gutegura.

setup.title: Gutegura igikoresho
setup.intro: Genzura tableti, wemeze ahantu n'umunsi, wandike igikoresho mbere yo gukoresha sitasiyo iyo ari yo yose.
setup.blocked_body: Konga ibyafunze hejuru. Kugeza ubwo, koresha impapuro: andika ku rupapuro, uzabyandike nyuma.
setup.ready_body: Iki gikoresho gishobora gufata amakuru. Fungura sitasiyo muri urutonde.
setup.venue_help: Andika kode ya kampanye, akarere n'itariki y'ikizamini. Seriveri irabyemeza.
setup.venue_not_found: Nta hantu habonetse kuri iyi kampanye, akarere n'itariki.
setup.venue_forbidden: Konti yawe ntishobora gusoma aha hantu.
setup.venue_offline: Nta murongo na seriveri. Ongera ugerageze.
setup.venue_other: Seriveri ntiyashoboye kwemeza ahantu. Ongera ugerageze.
setup.enrol_help: Kwandika byohereza urufunguzo rusange gusa. Urufunguzo rwihariye ntirurenga kuri iyi tableti.
setup.enrol_no_permission: Saba umukozi ushinzwe kugenzura cyangwa umugenzuzi kwandika iki gikoresho.
setup.enrol_revoked: Iki gikoresho cyavanyweho kandi ntigishobora kongera kwandikwa.
setup.enrol_offline: Nta murongo na seriveri. Ongera ugerageze.
setup.anchor_help: Si itegeko. Uru rufunguzo rutuma tableti igenzura ikarita nta murongo. Ntirushobora kwinjiza umuntu.
setup.runtime_failed_body: Ububiko bwizewe cyangwa gusinya ntibiboneka muri iyi porogaramu. Koresha impapuro.

physical.title: Ikizamini cy'umubiri
physical.intro: Soma ikarita, wandike ibipimo. Buri nyandiko irasinywa kandi seriveri igomba kuyemeza.
physical.blocked_body: Iki gikoresho nticyiteguye. Koresha urupapuro urangize gutegura.
physical.out_of_range: Bitari hagati ya {{min}} na {{max}}. Ongera upime.
physical.reason_label: Impamvu ako gaciro gasigaye (nyuma yo gupima ukundi)
physical.offline_body: Inyandiko zibitswe kuri iyi tableti ariko ntizigeze kuri seriveri. Andika ibisubizo ku rupapuro.
physical.duplicate_body: Iyi nyandiko yoherejwe mbere. Nta cyongeweho.
physical.paper_prompt: Andika ibisubizo ku rupapuro ubu. Iyi nyandiko iri kuri iyi tableti gusa.
physical.conflict_body: Seriveri irafashe aya manota kuko ibindi bipimo bivuguruzanya. Umugenzuzi agomba kubikemura.

medical.title: Sitasiyo y'ubuvuzi
medical.intro_BOARD: Andika icyemezo cy'akanama k'abaganga ku mukandida wasomwe.
medical.intro_CERTIFICATE: Andika icyemezo cy'umuganga wa Leta ku mukandida wasomwe.
medical.no_mode_body: Iki kigo nta buryo bw'ubuvuzi gifite kuri iyi sitasiyo.
medical.offline_body: Nta cyanditswe. Koresha urupapuro, uzabyandike hari umurongo.

supervisor.title: Umugenzuzi
supervisor.intro: Imibare y'ahantu, inyandiko z'iyi tableti n'ibikoresho byose.
supervisor.no_venue_day: Nta hantu n'umunsi byemejwe kuri iyi tableti.
supervisor.counts: Bategerejwe {{expected}}, binjiye {{admitted}}, ikizamini cy'umubiri {{physicalCaptured}}, ubuvuzi {{medicalRecorded}}, amakimbirane afunguye {{openConflicts}}
supervisor.sync_summary: Inyandiko {{total}}: {{acknowledged}} kuri seriveri, {{waiting}} zitoherejwe, {{refused}} zanzwe, {{conflicts}} mu makimbirane
supervisor.fleet_no_permission: Kureba tableti zose bisaba uruhushya rwo gucunga ibikoresho.
supervisor.manual_identity: Kumenyekanisha ku ntoki: umukandida yinjizwa ku muryango akoresheje ikarita n'indangamuntu yanditswe. Isura itahuye ntiyigera ituma umuntu yangwa.
